TITLE: Ever Works
UNAVAILABLE: The Ever Works integration is not switched on for this installation. Its operator can switch it on with EVER_WORKS_ENABLED=true; until then nothing is sent to Ever Works.
ERROR: The Ever Works integration could not be loaded. Please try again.
READY: The Ever Works integration is switched on for this installation.
INTRO: Connect this organization to an Ever Works organization with an Ever Works integration key (it starts with ew_int_). Tasks, teams, goals, missions, ideas, agents, docs and the inbox then sync in both directions.
CONNECT_SOON: Connecting from this page arrives with the next release of the integration.

CONNECTED.TITLE: This organization syncs with the Ever Works organization {{ name }}.
CONNECTED.INACTIVE: The connection is {{ status }}: nothing syncs until it is resumed or gets a new key. Open the sync settings to fix it.

KEY.TITLE: Create an integration key in Ever Works
KEY.STEP_1: In Ever Works, open Settings → API keys → New key and choose the type Integration (the link below opens it with the "Ever Gauzy" preset).
KEY.STEP_2: Name the key, for example "Ever Gauzy — {{ organization }}".
KEY.STEP_3: Pin the key to the Ever Works organizations to sync.
KEY.STEP_5: Copy the key: it is shown once and starts with ew_int_.
KEY.NO_APP_URL: Open Ever Works and go to Settings → API keys.

CONNECT.API_URL_HINT: The address of the Ever Works API, ending in /api (for example https://<your Ever Works API host>/api). Self-hosted, stage and dev addresses work too (HTTPS, no query or fragment).
CONNECT.KEY_HINT: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
CONNECT.MISSING_SCOPES: The key lacks these scopes of the "Ever Gauzy" preset; what they cover does not sync: {{ scopes }}
CONNECT.MISSING_REQUIRED: The key lacks scopes the connection cannot work without: {{ scopes }}. Create a key with the "Ever Gauzy" preset.
CONNECT.INCOMPATIBLE: This Ever Works speaks integration API v{{ version }}; this Gauzy speaks another version. Nothing can be connected.
CONNECT.EXISTING: This tenant is already connected to the Ever Works tenant {{ tenant }} (key {{ key }}).
CONNECT.STATUS_NOT_ACTIVE: The connection is {{ status }}: resume it, use a new key or disconnect below, then map this organization.

ORGANIZATION.TITLE: Map this organization to one of the key's pinned Ever Works organizations.
ORGANIZATION.NONE_PINNED: The key is pinned to no Ever Works organization.

REVIEW.INTRO: Only a shared Ever ID pairs people by itself: confirm the suggestions, pair by hand, or leave a record unpaired.
REVIEW.INITIATIVES_INTRO: Ever Works missions sync with Gauzy strategic initiatives. An Ever Works mission created from a Gauzy initiative starts paused (only Ever Works starts its work), a draft initiative goes to Ever Works once it is active, and leadership initiatives never sync.
REVIEW.INITIATIVES_UNAVAILABLE: Pairing initiatives with missions is not available on this installation yet.
REVIEW.INITIATIVE_DRAFT: draft: goes to Ever Works once it is active
REVIEW.MISSIONS_ONE_WAY: Initiatives are created in Ever Works only when Missions ↔ Initiatives syncs both ways (Entities and directions).
REVIEW.TEAMS_ONE_WAY: Gauzy teams are created in Ever Works only when Teams syncs to Ever Works (Entities and directions).
REVIEW.MAPPING_OFF_NO_CREATE: Switch the mapping on to create records on the other side.
REVIEW.DEFERRED_INBOX: Inbox items waiting for a pairing
REVIEW.DEFERRED_INBOX_HINT: Ever Works addressed these inbox items to members who are not paired with a Gauzy person yet, so they were not delivered. Pair the member above and their items arrive in their Gauzy Inbox.
REVIEW.AGENTS_INTRO: Ever Works agents become Gauzy employees of kind "agent" when the sync starts. They are managed by Ever Works: edits made in Gauzy are not pushed.
REVIEW.PROJECTS_UNAVAILABLE: Pairing projects with works is not available on this installation yet.
REVIEW.DUPLICATE_CHOICE: The same Gauzy record is chosen for two Ever Works records. Choose it for one of them only.

INVITE.GAUZY_PENDING: Invited to Gauzy: the invitation is pending
INVITE.GAUZY_PEOPLE: Gauzy people with no Ever Works member
INVITE.CONFIRM_EVER_WORKS_TITLE: Invite this person to Ever Works?
INVITE.ORGANIZATION_GAUZY: The Gauzy organization this mapping syncs
INVITE.ORGANIZATION_EVER_WORKS: The Ever Works organization this mapping syncs
INVITE.ROLE_EMPLOYEE: Employee (the role whose acceptance creates a person to pair; change it in Gauzy once they have joined)
INVITE.ROLE_MEMBER: Member (an Ever Works owner promotes members)
INVITE.CONFIRM_GAUZY_HINT: Gauzy sends its invitation email. Nothing is paired: once they join, their verified email suggests the pairing here.
INVITE.CONFIRM_EVER_WORKS_HINT: Ever Works sends its invitation email, as your paired Ever Works user (or the integration key owner). Nothing is paired: once they join, pair them here.

RESULT.pending: An invitation is already pending; nothing was sent again
RESULT.already_member: Already a member of the Ever Works organization: pair them above
RESULT.added: Added to the Ever Works organization: pair them above

DIRECTIONS.INTRO: Choose what syncs and in which direction. Records that are private in Ever Works never sync.
DIRECTIONS.SYNC_UNLINKED_PROJECT_TASKS: Also sync tasks of projects that are not paired with a work

DOMAINS.agentEmail: Agent email (a read-only copy in the Inbox)

PREVIEW.INTRO: A dry run: what the first sync reads, pairs and creates. Nothing is written until you start it.
PREVIEW.WEBHOOK_NOT_REGISTERED: Ever Works could not register its webhook ({{ reason }}); the change feed keeps the sync going.

SETTINGS.NOT_FOUND: This page belongs to an Ever Works mapping of another organization, or to one that no longer exists. Select its organization, or connect this one.
SETTINGS.BACK_TO_CONNECT: Open the Ever Works page of this organization

CONNECTION_STATE.paused: The connection is paused: nothing is read from or sent to Ever Works until it is resumed.
CONNECTION_STATE.needs_reauth: Ever Works no longer accepts the integration key (revoked or expired). Enter a new key in Advanced.
CONNECTION_STATE.error: The last health check of the connection failed; see the error below.

SETTINGS.QUEUE: {{ pending }} pending, {{ deferred }} deferred, {{ failed }} retrying, {{ dead }} stopped
SETTINGS.RUN_CANCELLED: The sync was cancelled; what it applied stays.
SETTINGS.FIRST_SYNC: This organization has not synced yet
SETTINGS.USED_OTHER: The other value was written and is being synced.
SETTINGS.ENABLED: Sync this organization with Ever Works
SETTINGS.ENABLED_ON: Syncing is on for this organization.
SETTINGS.ENABLED_OFF: Syncing is off for this organization; nothing is read or sent until it is on again.
SETTINGS.KEY_CURRENT: Current key: {{ name }} ({{ prefix }}). A new key must belong to the same Ever Works tenant; the old one keeps working until Ever Works retires it.
SETTINGS.KEY_ROTATED: The new key is in use.
SETTINGS.DISCONNECT_HINT: Disconnecting stops the sync for every organization of this tenant and removes the Ever Works webhook. Synced data stays on both sides, and the pairings are kept for a reconnect.
SETTINGS.DISCONNECT_WEBHOOK_KEPT: Disconnected, but Ever Works could not delete the webhook subscription, so it may keep sending events (Gauzy refuses them). Revoke the integration key in Ever Works (Settings → API keys), which disables its webhooks. Reconnecting to the same Ever Works tenant tries to delete it again.
